mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.description, p.price, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.version, c.id AS categoryId, c.name AS categoryName, ps.stock_quantity AS stockQuantity FROM products p INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id INNER JOIN product_stocks ps ON p.id = ps.product_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = FALSE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products ( category_id, name, description, price, image_url, version, deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{categoryId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{imageUrl}, 0, FALSE, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, category_id AS categoryId, name, description, price, image_url AS imageUrl, version, deleted, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM products WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET category_id = #{categoryId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, price = #{price}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, version = version + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = FALSE
